title: When in Doubt, Cascade: Towards Building Efficient and Capable Guardrails
findings: The paper's proposed 'cascade' approach, trained on synthetically generated data, significantly reduces false positive rates in detecting social bias. For religion, this means the models are better able to distinguish between harmful text (use) and benign discussion about a religious group (mention). For example, their 'cascade-orig' model correctly classified a complex, non-harmful sentence about 'British Muslims' as safe, whereas the Llama-Guard-2 baseline incorrectly flagged it as unsafe.
